args.question:
Delta Printworks (V-940) has two approved invoices, so I haven't sent anything yet. Which one should I pay by wire from the operating account?
1. INV-16558: $5,080.75, due 2026-11-04
2. INV-40128: $1,311.11, due 2026-11-25
(A third invoice, INV-26409 for $1,207.43, is still a draft awaiting approval, and INV-57614 is already paid.) Reply with the invoice ID and I'll send the wire for the full amount once.
